summary.method: OpenAlex has NO institution record for EPNU (searches 'East Port Said', 'East Port Said National University', 'Port Said National', 'EPNU' returned 0 institutions), so works were found via raw_affiliation_strings.search ('East Port Said', 'East Port Said National University', 'EPNU', 'East Port-Said', 'New Port Said', 'Port Said National University'; 156 distinct candidates). Every raw affiliation string was regex-checked locally and a work was kept only if a string names East Port Said National University / EPNU (the search is loose and also returns East Port Said University of Technology and Port Said University). Crossref query.affiliation (3 queries, 600 rows each, regex-filtered; 15 hits, 1 new) and Europe PMC AFF search (56 hits with EPNU in author affiliations, 1 new) were used to cross-check; union deduplicated by DOI = 85 records. Four non-papers (2 errata, 1 dataset, 1 preprint) were excluded, leaving 81 papers/chapters. Field = OpenAlex primary_topic field (automatic classification). Co-author countries = OpenAlex authorship countries, excluding Egypt.
caveats: All 81 are publications dated 2024-2026; none earlier, consistent with a university founded c. 2024.
2026 count is partial (retrieved Oct 2026); OpenAlex 'published' dates for online-first items may lag.

East Port Said University of Technology (EPSUT, a different institution, ~100 further affiliation strings) and Port Said University-only papers were deliberately excluded. Some authors list both EPNU and PSU/EPSUT; they are counted once if EPNU is named.

Scopus/WoS indexing and Q-rank are NOT available through OpenAlex (is_indexed_in_scopus is null for all sources). The 'openalex_core_source' flag is only a proxy; 73 of 81 papers appear in OpenAlex core sources, but this is not a Scopus or WoS confirmation. Verify via Scopus Sources / JCR before claiming indexing.

'International' = publisher is not Egyptian. Two papers are in Egyptian-edited journals published by Springer Nature (Future Journal of Pharmaceutical Sciences; Egyptian Journal of Internal Medicine) and are counted as international by publisher; 2 papers are in EKB-hosted Egyptian journals (Al-Azhar Eng. Sector; Octahedron Drug Research).

Co-author countries rely on OpenAlex institution matching; authors whose affiliations were not resolved show no country, so the list is likely a lower bound and the per-country counts are author-instances, not papers. Co-authors from other Egyptian institutions are not counted as international.

Field labels are OpenAlex automatic topic assignments and are sometimes imperfect (e.g. a few pharmacy/chemistry papers labelled Neuroscience or Materials Science). Faculty-level attribution (Pharmacy, Engineering, Applied Health Sciences) comes from the affiliation strings; the majority of output is pharmacy/medicinal chemistry and engineering.

Likely undercounting: indexing lag (2026 items), inconsistent or truncated affiliation strings (e.g. 'East Port Said University', 'Port Said National'), unresolved affiliations in Crossref metadata, and EPNU staff who publish only under Port Said University or other home institutions.
Two records (10.3390/ph19101531, 10.1002/ddr.70364) were found via Crossref/Europe PMC but OpenAlex lacks the EPNU raw string for them.
